logoSource.Production Note: Cache the final production asset into Foundshore R2. For Tier B, download the official SVG/PNG from the media kit and replace the fallback URL in production.

facts_raw.Funding / Support: Typically $500K–$1M initial commitment + ~$650K partner credits for companies Antler backs
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: After residency investment evaluation; every Resident gets a genuine opportunity to be considered
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Current US page does not publish a single fixed 2026 equity percentage for the typical $500K–$1M commitment; exact investment terms are deal-specific/publicly undisclosed on current location page.
facts_raw.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Amount Public / Exact Equity Not Publicly Disclosed
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: At least one cofounder must already have independent, indefinite and unrestricted US work authorization.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Genuine intent to start a venture; meaningful community participation; serious engagement in Antler investment process; at least one founder full-time in residency.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: In-person in NYC, SF or Austin for up to 3 months; at least one founder must be full-time in residency.
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: Antler explicitly does not sponsor visas for US residency.
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
